headline: WEST POINT GOLD DRILLS 66m AT 6.57 g/t — NE TYRO ZONE REACHES 250m DEPTH AHEAD OF ARIZONA MAIDEN RESOURCE
source_name: InvestorIdeas / West Point Gold Corp. (TSXV: WPG)
snippet: West Point Gold Corp. (TSXV: WPG) announced June 23 that hole GC26-148 at the Gold Chain Project in Arizona intersected 66.2 metres at 6.57 g/t gold from 219m depth — including 20.7m at 18.25 g/t — the broadest and highest-grade intercept yet at the NE Tyro Zone, extending high-grade mineralization beyond 250m below surface. Assays from 21 additional holes totalling 6,550m remain pending and will be incorporated into the company's upcoming maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate expected in H2 2026.

headline: CUBA SANCTIONS KILL NORTH AMERICA'S ONLY COBALT REFINERY — FORT SASKATCHEWAN IDLE, RESTART DATE UNKNOWN
snippet: Sherritt International confirmed June 22 that its Fort Saskatchewan, Alberta refinery — North America's only commercially operating cobalt refinery — is transitioning to a controlled shutdown after the Trump administration's May 1 Executive Order expanding Cuba sanctions cut off all feedstock supply from the Moa joint venture in Cuba, with no guidance provided on when mining and processing at Moa could resume or the feed pipeline be rebuilt. The closure removes a meaningful slice of non-Chinese cobalt from western battery supply chains at a time when EV manufacturers are already under pressure to diversify away from DRC-origin material.

headline: RIO2 CONDESTABLE: 82.1 Mt AT 0.69% COPPER — $710M NPV8% AND 14-YEAR PERU MINE LIFE CONFIRMED IN UPDATED 43-101
source_name: Investing News Network / Rio2 Limited (TSX: RIO)
snippet: Rio2 Limited (TSX: RIO) announced June 23 an updated NI 43-101 technical report for the Condestable underground copper mine in Lima Department, Peru confirming 82.1 million tonnes at 0.69% Cu in Measured and Indicated resources, 22.2 million tonnes at 0.76% Cu Inferred, a 14-year mine life extended through 2039, and an after-tax NPV at an 8% discount rate of US$710 million. The report positions Condestable as a platform asset for Rio2's dual-commodity gold-copper strategy, providing operating cashflow to support continued advancement of the Fenix gold project in Chile.

headline: TOUBANI HITS 86.5 g/t GOLD AT KOBADA — PRE-PRODUCTION MALI DRILLING SHOWS HIGH-GRADE CORE AHEAD OF Q3 RESOURCE UPDATE
snippet: Toubani Resources (ASX: TRE) released June 23 high-grade RC drilling results from the Kobada gold project in southern Mali, including 1m at 116 g/t Au, 1.7m at 97.4 g/t Au, 20m at 4.58 g/t from 198m depth, and 61m at 1.80 g/t from 183m — all within the current pre-production infill campaign of which approximately 30,000 of 60,000 budgeted metres have now been drilled. A mineral resource estimate update is scheduled for Q3 2026 ahead of targeted mining activities commencing in early 2027, making this the last major resource-definition dataset before a production decision.

headline: FPX NICKEL: FOUR AWARUITE TARGETS DELINEATED AT ADVOCATE — INAUGURAL JOGMEC JV DRILL LAUNCHING IN NEWFOUNDLAND
source_name: Junior Mining Network / FPX Nickel Corp. (TSXV: FPX)
snippet: FPX Nickel Corp. (TSXV: FPX) announced June 23 that bedrock sampling at the Advocate Nickel Property in central Newfoundland has delineated four large-scale drill-ready awaruite nickel targets through its JOGMEC joint venture — including Birchy North (800 x 350m, up to 0.13% DTR Ni) and Wolverine (2,400 x 650m, up to 0.14% DTR Ni) — with an inaugural drill program planned for summer 2026. Awaruite is a sulfide-free native nickel alloy that does not require conventional sulphide processing and produces no acid drainage, making it a strategically distinct battery-quality nickel type with a simplified permitting and processing path.

headline: BLUE STAR GOLD DRILLS TWO NUNAVUT TARGETS — 8,000m PHASE 2 UNDERWAY AT NUTAAQ AND AUMA AS SUMMER SEASON OPENS
source_name: Investing News Network / Blue Star Gold Corp. (TSXV: BAU)
snippet: Blue Star Gold Corp. (TSXV: BAU) confirmed June 23 that Phase 2 drilling is underway with one drill active at the North Nutaaq gold target and a second coring the Bamako target at the Auma Project, kicking off an 8,000-metre summer program across its Nunavut portfolio. Phase 1 surface sampling had returned grades up to 115.5 g/t Au along a 1.6km Nutaaq trend, establishing the geological framework for the first drill-testing of a corridor that also carries critical mineral targets for mid-July.

headline: CASCADE COPPER FIRES MAIDEN HOLES INTO VMS TARGET — CENTREFIRE COPPER-GOLD PROGRAM STARTS NEAR DRYDEN, ONTARIO
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Cascade Copper Corp. (CSE: CASC)
snippet: Cascade Copper Corp. (CSE: CASC) announced June 23 that it has commenced a maiden drill program at the Centrefire Copper-Gold Project, 40 kilometres from Dryden in northwestern Ontario, with the first hole collared on a high-priority Volcanogenic Massive Sulphide copper-gold target defined by geophysical inversion modelling and confirmed surface mineralization. VMS deposits in the Wabigoon Subprovince of the Superior Craton have produced some of Ontario's most significant base metal mines historically, and the Centrefire target represents the company's first drill test of a geophysically defined conductor with surface copper-gold showings.

headline: HOT PMI 55.7 CRUSHES GOLD: JUNE MANUFACTURING BEATS BY 1.1 POINTS — FED HIKE ODDS RISE AS METALS SLIP TO $4,130
snippet: The S&P Global June Flash US Manufacturing PMI printed 55.7 on June 23, beating the consensus estimate of 54.6 and the prior month's 55.1 — the strongest reading in the data series for 2026 — reinforcing the economic resilience narrative that is the primary short-term headwind for gold and increasing the probability that the Federal Reserve under Chair Kevin Warsh delivers a rate hike before year-end. Gold fell below $4,150 on the print; the next pivotal data for precious metals investors is Friday's Core PCE inflation reading, which remains the single most reliable trigger for a repricing of rate expectations in either direction.

headline: UBS CUTS NEAR-TERM GOLD TARGET TO $3,850–$4,000 — 'DOUBLE WHAMMY' OF STRONG DATA AND DELAYED RATE CUTS CITED
snippet: UBS strategists have cut their near-term gold price target to the $3,850–$4,000 per ounce range, citing a 'double whammy' of stronger-than-expected US economic data and a delayed Federal Reserve easing cycle under Chair Kevin Warsh, implying a further 3–7% downside from the current level near $4,130. Despite the near-term cut, UBS maintains a 12-month bullish view anchored on central bank demand projected at 750–1,000 metric tonnes annually, noting that current corrections driven by interest rate expectations rather than structural demand changes have historically been resolved by the next major soft data print.

headline: KITCO: MINING STOCKS OFFER BIGGER ENTRY THAN GOLD ITSELF — GDXJ DISCOUNT TO SPOT SIGNALS NEXT BUYING OPPORTUNITY
snippet: Kitco News analysis published June 23 argues that junior and mid-tier mining stocks are now pricing in gold materially below current spot levels following the June correction, making the GDXJ cohort a structurally better tactical entry than physical gold or silver at the current $4,130 level. The piece identifies that the GDX and GDXJ have corrected disproportionately more than spot metals since the January 2026 peak, a divergence that historically resolves through rapid share-price re-convergence once investor sentiment stabilizes — a pattern consistent with every previous major correction low in the 2024–2026 gold bull market.
